sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Kuwait visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Kuwait, and can apply online for an eVisa or get one on arrival.

sections.heading: Kuwait visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports may need to apply through the Kuwaiti Embassy, depending on their nationality. Work and family visas need a sponsor in Kuwait.

sections.heading: Working in Kuwait
sections.text: Work visas start with your employer in Kuwait, and usually need your degree certificate and police certificate legalised. We arrange the legalisation of UK documents as part of our service.

sections.heading: Kuwait visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Kuwait visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Kuwait.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Kuwait from the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. British citizens can apply online for an eVisa or get a visa on arrival.

faqs.q: How long does a Kuwait visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Kuwait visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Kuwait visa application and submit it for you.
